note: Routine mail placed before the target email (one or two per episode). Researcher-authored; not on the drive. None touches a scenario topic (no K-9 or donations, emergency alerts or the CR 20 fire's alerts, extra-duty billing or Tamlin, release cards or inmate account balances, jail medical or nursing). r2 thanks the posse for the fire but asks nothing about alerts; r6 and r12 use the visitor guide and the lobby phone guide (visits, bond) only. The bulk agent should make sure ordinary drive files can answer them: CHP renewal process and appointments (Civil and Records), Coffee with the Sheriff time and place (Oct 20, Rocky Ford; add location), civil process service and fees, CR 31 traffic and school bus stop (patrol schedule or a traffic-enforcement plan), crash/incident report copies and fees, VIN inspections (who, when, fee), school talk requests, trespass/hunting calls versus Colorado Parks and Wildlife, the Sept 14 fire restriction resolution, and 24-hour bond payment.

emails.name: Dale Ehrlich
emails.address: 1415 San Juan Ave, La Junta CO 81050
emails.body:
My concealed carry permit expires in December. Do I need an appointment to renew or can I just walk in? And what do I need to bring?

Thanks
Dale

emails.name: Ruth Ann Kasza
emails.body:
Sheriff,

I just wanted to say thank you to the posse folks who hauled our two horses to the fairgrounds during the fire. My husband is laid up with his knee and I could not have done it myself. They were so kind. Please tell them.

Ruth Ann Kasza

emails.name: Mike Torrez
emails.body: Saw on facebook you are doing a coffee in Rocky Ford. What time and where exactly? I want to bring a couple guys from the VFW.

emails.name: Brenda Lusk
emails.body:
I need to have papers served on my ex for a small claims case. How does that work with your office and how much does it cost? Do I bring them to you or does the court send them?

Brenda Lusk

emails.name: Gary Nichols
emails.body:
The trucks and pickups fly down CR 31 past the school bus stop every morning. 60+ easy. We never see a deputy out here. Somebody is going to get killed. Can you put somebody out here at 7 am even a couple days a week?

Gary Nichols

emails.name: Kayla Ruybalid
emails.body: hi my boyfriend is in the jail. can I bring our baby to visit him in person and what days? do I need to make an appointment

emails.name: Paul Hostetler
emails.body:
Someone backed into my truck at the grocery store parking lot in Rocky Ford and a deputy took a report on October 10. My insurance wants a copy. How do I get it and is there a fee?

Paul Hostetler

emails.name: Sherry Gonzales
emails.body:
Following up, I called last week and left a message. I bought a trailer from out of state and the DMV says I need a VIN inspection. Do you guys do that and when? Nobody called me back.

Sherry

emails.name: Angela Mora
emails.address: Swink School, 610 Columbia Ave, Swink CO 81077
emails.body:
Sheriff Strohm, our 5th graders are doing a unit on community helpers. Would you or a deputy be able to come talk to them for 30 minutes sometime in November? Mornings are best. Thank you!

Angela Mora, 5th grade

emails.name: Ron Wahlert
emails.body: Every fall we get hunters driving in on our ground without asking and shooting from the road. Who do I call when it's happening, you or Parks and Wildlife? I'd rather not wait an hour.

emails.name: Linda Pruitt
emails.body:
The fire danger is still so high and people are still burning trash out in the county. Why did the commissioners lift the fire restrictions in September? I think they should be put back until it snows.

Linda

emails.name: Tom Archuleta
emails.body: My nephew got picked up last night. If the judge sets a bond can I pay it there at the jail at night or do I have to wait till the court opens? Do you take cards?
